CozyUI+ v1.10 font resources

Resource pack author: 零雾〇五 (Fogg05)
Source archive: CozyUI+_v1.10.zip

WurstB+ Plus embeds only the font definitions and their referenced bitmap
atlases. The embedded resources override Minecraft's default and uniform font
definitions so the same typeface is used throughout Minecraft and WurstB+ Plus.

License files distributed with the source archive are preserved in this
directory:

- CozyUI-GPL-3.0.txt
- NotoSans-OFL-1.1.txt
- FluentEmoji-MIT.txt
